topic: Groq Free API tier (1,000 RPD, 200K TPD, 8K TPM trap)
caption:
Save this before paying $20/month for an AI coding API key.

If you're hunting for a free AI API for student developer tools, Groq's free tier gives 1,000 requests and 200,000 tokens daily on models like gpt-oss-120b and qwen3.8-27b. Whisper Turbo gets 2,000 requests daily too.

Watch the 8,000 tokens-per-minute cap. Dump a whole codebase in one prompt and you'll hit a 413 error fast, so keep prompts small.
